section: Food security - NFSA 2013, PDS reform, buffer stocks, One Nation One Ration Card, PMGKAY
subsections: NFSA 2013 - coverage, entitlements, maternity benefit, State Food Commission, grievance redress

accepted.s: The National Food Security Act, 2013, provides which of the following to eligible persons?
o: A statutory right to minimum agricultural wages
A constitutional right to free electricity
A legal and justiciable right to subsidised foodgrains
A legal right to universal employment
accepted.x: The NFSA provides a legal and justiciable right to subsidised foodgrains and food and nutritional security.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact legal character of the Act rather than confusing it with a constitutional entitlement.
accepted.sec: NFSA 2013 - coverage, entitlements, maternity benefit, State Food Commission, grievance redress  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The National Food Security Act, 2013, commenced in which month and year?
o: January 2012
July 2013
April 2015
September 2014
accepted.x: The NFSA commenced in July 2013.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the enactment period and the commencement date.
accepted.sec: NFSA 2013 - coverage, entitlements, maternity benefit, State Food Commission, grievance redress  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which Ministry is primarily responsible for administering the National Food Security Act, 2013?
o: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
Ministry of Women and Child Development
Ministry of Rural Development
Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
accepted.x: The NFSA is administered by the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution.
accepted.tq: Use the ministry-identification trap by distinguishing the food-distribution ministry from neighbouring ministries.
accepted.sec: NFSA 2013 - coverage, entitlements, maternity benefit, State Food Commission, grievance redress  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under the National Food Security Act, the maximum coverage prescribed for the urban population is:
o: 40 per cent
50 per cent
67 per cent
75 per cent
accepted.x: The NFSA provides for coverage of up to 50 per cent of the urban population and up to 75 per cent of the rural population.
accepted.tq: Split the rural and urban coverage figures before selecting the precise percentage.
accepted.sec: NFSA 2013 - coverage, entitlements, maternity benefit, State Food Commission, grievance redress  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The combined NFSA coverage of up to 75 per cent of the rural population and 50 per cent of the urban population is approximately equal to:
o: The entire population of India
One-half of India’s population
Two-thirds of India’s population
One-fourth of India’s population
accepted.x: The prescribed rural and urban coverage together amount to approximately two-thirds, or about 67 per cent, of India’s population.
accepted.tq: Translate separate coverage percentages into the broad national proportion.
accepted.sec: NFSA 2013 - coverage, entitlements, maternity benefit, State Food Commission, grievance redress  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under the NFSA, the entitlement of a Priority Household is:
o: 35 kg of foodgrains per person per month
5 kg of foodgrains per household per month
5 kg of foodgrains per person per month
7 kg of foodgrains per household per month
accepted.x: A Priority Household is entitled to 5 kg of foodgrains per person per month.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the per-person entitlement of a Priority Household from the per-household entitlement of AAY.
accepted.sec: NFSA 2013 - coverage, entitlements, maternity benefit, State Food Commission, grievance redress  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly represents the entitlement of an Antyodaya Anna Yojana household under the NFSA?
o: 5 kg per person per month
50 kg per household per month
7 kg per person without any household ceiling
35 kg per household per month
accepted.x: An AAY household is entitled to 35 kg of foodgrains per household per month under the NFSA framework.
accepted.tq: Watch the distinction between person-based and household-based quantities.
accepted.sec: NFSA 2013 - coverage, entitlements, maternity benefit, State Food Commission, grievance redress  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The issue prices prescribed in the NFSA for rice, wheat and coarse grains, respectively, are:
o: Rs 2, Rs 3 and Rs 1 per kg
Rs 3, Rs 2 and Rs 1 per kg
Rs 3, Rs 1 and Rs 2 per kg
Rs 1, Rs 2 and Rs 3 per kg
accepted.x: The Act prescribes issue prices of Rs 3 per kg for rice, Rs 2 for wheat and Rs 1 for coarse grains.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure rice pair and retain the exact order of the three commodities.
accepted.sec: NFSA 2013 - coverage, entitlements, maternity benefit, State Food Commission, grievance redress  [APPSC]

accepted.s: From 1 January 2023, NFSA foodgrains have been distributed free of cost under PMGKAY. This arrangement has been extended up to:
o: 31 December 2028
31 March 2027
31 December 2025
31 December 2030
accepted.x: The free distribution of NFSA foodgrains under PMGKAY, beginning on 1 January 2023, has been extended up to 31 December 2028.
accepted.tq: Separate the commencement date from the extension end date.
accepted.sec: NFSA 2013 - coverage, entitlements, maternity benefit, State Food Commission, grievance redress  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under Section 4 of the National Food Security Act, pregnant women and lactating mothers are entitled to:
o: A cash benefit of Rs 3,000 without meals
Only subsidised foodgrains for six months
Free meals and maternity benefit of not less than Rs 6,000
35 kg of foodgrains per household
accepted.x: Section 4 provides pregnant women and lactating mothers with free meals and a maternity benefit of not less than Rs 6,000.
accepted.tq: Combine the two components of the entitlement instead of selecting the cash or meal component alone.
accepted.sec: NFSA 2013 - coverage, entitlements, maternity benefit, State Food Commission, grievance redress  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
With reference to grievance redress under the NFSA, consider the following statements:
1. An internal grievance-redress mechanism is provided.
2. A District Grievance Redressal Officer is provided under Section 15.
3. A State Food Commission is constituted in every State to monitor implementation and hear appeals.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 and 2 only
1 and 3 only
2 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The NFSA provides an internal mechanism and District Grievance Redressal Officers, while State Food Commissions monitor implementation and hear appeals.
accepted.tq: Check the institutional chain from the internal mechanism to district and State-level bodies.
accepted.sec: NFSA 2013 - coverage, entitlements, maternity benefit, State Food Commission, grievance redress  [APPSC]

accepted.s: For the purpose of issuing a ration card under the NFSA, the head of the household should ordinarily be:
o: The eldest male member irrespective of age
The elected ward member
The person holding the Aadhaar card with the highest income
The eldest woman who is at least 18 years old
accepted.x: The eldest woman of the household, provided she is 18 years or older, is treated as the head for issuing the ration card.
accepted.tq: Apply the women-empowerment provision precisely, including the minimum age condition.
accepted.sec: NFSA 2013 - coverage, entitlements, maternity benefit, State Food Commission, grievance redress  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The draft National Food Security (Amendment) Bill, 2026 proposes to replace the AAY household entitlement with:
o: 7 kg per person, subject to an overall ceiling of 35 kg per household
35 kg per person, subject to an overall ceiling of 70 kg per household
10 kg per household, subject to a ceiling of 50 kg
5 kg per person, without a household ceiling
accepted.x: The draft Bill proposes 7 kg per person for AAY households, while retaining an overall cap of 35 kg per household.
accepted.tq: Read both parts of the proposed formula: the per-person figure and the household cap.
accepted.sec: NFSA 2013 - coverage, entitlements, maternity benefit, State Food Commission, grievance redress  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The proposed amendment to the AAY entitlement is intended principally to address which issue?
o: The inequity whereby smaller households receive more foodgrains per head
The shortage of Aadhaar-seeded ration cards
The lack of portability between States
The rising economic cost of foodgrain procurement
accepted.x: The stated aim is to remove the inequity under which smaller AAY households receive a greater quantity per person when the entitlement is fixed per household.
accepted.tq: Identify the policy rationale rather than confusing it with digitisation, portability or procurement issues.
accepted.sec: NFSA 2013 - coverage, entitlements, maternity benefit, State Food Commission, grievance redress  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following groups opposed the draft National Food Security (Amendment) Bill, 2026?
o: Tamil Nadu, Kerala and the CPI(M)
Odisha, Assam and the Election Commission
Gujarat, Rajasthan and NITI Aayog
Punjab, Haryana and the RBI
accepted.x: Tamil Nadu, Kerala and the CPI(M) opposed the proposed amendment.
accepted.tq: Test the exact combination of political and State actors rather than a single-name association.
accepted.sec: NFSA 2013 - coverage, entitlements, maternity benefit, State Food Commission, grievance redress  [APPSC]

accepted.s: One Nation One Ration Card primarily enables:
o: Universal issue of new ration cards to urban residents
Inter-State portability of NFSA ration-card entitlements
Direct transfer of MSP to migrant workers
Replacement of all ration cards by voter identity cards
accepted.x: ONORC enables nationwide portability of NFSA ration-card entitlements, particularly benefiting migrant beneficiaries.
accepted.tq: Identify the central reform function and distinguish portability from replacement or cash transfer.
accepted.sec: One Nation One Ration Card - rollout deadline, Mera Ration app, IM-PDS  [APPSC]

accepted.s: A migrant NFSA beneficiary using ONORC may draw foodgrains at an ePoS-enabled fair price shop after:
o: Obtaining a new ration card in the destination State only
Receiving prior approval from the District Collector of both States
Surrendering the ration card to the destination fair price shop
Biometric or Aadhaar authentication, with the family able to draw the balance at home
accepted.x: ONORC permits a migrant to lift the full or partial entitlement at an ePoS-enabled fair price shop after biometric or Aadhaar authentication; the family can draw the balance at the original location.
accepted.tq: Trace the portability process from authentication to division of the household entitlement.
accepted.sec: One Nation One Ration Card - rollout deadline, Mera Ration app, IM-PDS  [APPSC]

accepted.s: One Nation One Ration Card was started in:
o: January 2018
June 2020
August 2019
April 2023
accepted.x: The ONORC initiative was started in August 2019; its nationwide coverage target was 1 June 2020.
accepted.tq: Separate the scheme’s starting date from its later nationwide rollout target.
accepted.sec: One Nation One Ration Card - rollout deadline, Mera Ration app, IM-PDS  [APPSC]

accepted.s: As reported for 2025-26, ONORC had been rolled out in:
o: All 28 States only
All States and 5 Union Territories
Only the States having inter-State migrant workers
All 36 States and Union Territories
accepted.x: ONORC has been rolled out in all 36 States and Union Territories, covering approximately 80 crore NFSA beneficiaries.
accepted.tq: Use the complete administrative coverage figure rather than a partial State-only description.
accepted.sec: One Nation One Ration Card - rollout deadline, Mera Ration app, IM-PDS  [APPSC]

accepted.s: During August 2019 to September 2025, ONORC recorded more than 187 crore portability transactions and approximately how much grain movement?
o: 44.3 LMT
187 LMT
443 LMT
accepted.x: The period recorded more than 187 crore transactions and approximately 443 LMT of grain movement, including PMGKAY transactions.
accepted.tq: Keep the transaction count and grain quantity separate while identifying the correct scale of the figure.
accepted.sec: One Nation One Ration Card - rollout deadline, Mera Ration app, IM-PDS  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes IM-PDS?
o: The national portability backbone of the Public Distribution System, operational from April 2018
A State-level foodgrain procurement portal launched in 2023
An urban housing programme approved for 2026-2031
A maternity-benefit platform operational from July 2013
accepted.x: IM-PDS is the Integrated Management of PDS and has functioned as the national portability backbone from April 2018.
accepted.tq: Match the scheme name with its function and commencement period.
accepted.sec: One Nation One Ration Card - rollout deadline, Mera Ration app, IM-PDS  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:
a. End-to-End Computerisation of TPDS — October 2012 to March 2020
b. IM-PDS — from April 2018
c. SMART-PDS — April 2023 to March 2026
d. SARTHAK-PDS — approved for 2026-2031
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
o: a and b only
a, b and c only
b, c and d only
a, b, c and d
accepted.x: All four pairs are correctly matched. End-to-End Computerisation covered October 2012-March 2020, IM-PDS began in April 2018, SMART-PDS covers April 2023-March 2026, and SARTHAK-PDS was approved for 2026-2031.
accepted.tq: Start with the distinctive time periods and verify every scheme-period pair.
accepted.sec: One Nation One Ration Card - rollout deadline, Mera Ration app, IM-PDS  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT a stated component or function of SARTHAK-PDS?
o: FPS dealer margin
Determination of the repo rate by the Reserve Bank of India
Intra-State movement of foodgrains
Monitoring using AI, ML, blockchain and NLP
accepted.x: SARTHAK-PDS covers intra-State movement, FPS dealer margin and SMART-PDS-related technology-based monitoring. Determination of the repo rate is not a function of SARTHAK-PDS.
accepted.tq: Find the unrelated institutional function among closely associated PDS reforms.
accepted.sec: One Nation One Ration Card - rollout deadline, Mera Ration app, IM-PDS

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements correctly describes the digitisation status of the Targeted Public Distribution System?
o: All ration cards are paper-based but all fair price shops use ePoS
About 50 per cent of ration cards are digitised and Aadhaar seeding is unavailable
Digitisation is confined to the Union Territories
Nearly 100 per cent of ration cards are digitised and about 99.9 per cent are Aadhaar-seeded
accepted.x: Approximately 100 per cent of ration cards have been digitised and about 99.9 per cent have been Aadhaar-seeded.
accepted.tq: Use the paired percentages together; the near-complete figures are the key distinction.
accepted.sec: One Nation One Ration Card - rollout deadline, Mera Ration app, IM-PDS

accepted.s: By the end of 2025, the number of fair price shops using ePoS was approximately:
o: 2.50 lakh out of 5.51 lakh
5.51 lakh out of 6.50 lakh
4.00 lakh out of 5.51 lakh
5.50 lakh out of 5.51 lakh
accepted.x: By the end of 2025, approximately 5.50 lakh of the 5.51 lakh fair price shops were using ePoS devices.
accepted.tq: Compare the numerator and denominator carefully in a near-complete implementation figure.
accepted.sec: One Nation One Ration Card - rollout deadline, Mera Ration app, IM-PDS
